text: {"us_status":"partial","label_product":"BOSULIF (bosutinib) tablets and capsules; Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc","label_version_or_date":"Revised 3/2026; DailyMed Pfizer label updated 2026-03-10","label_section":"6.1 Clinical Trials Experience — Additional Adverse Reactions From Multiple Clinical Trials","quote":"Skin and Subcutaneous Disorders: 0.1% and less than 1% - Erythema multiforme, Cutaneous vasculitis","eu":"EMA/PRAC recommended the bosutinib PI update on 2025-10-30; current EU Bosulif product information lists cutaneous vasculitis as an uncommon skin/subcutaneous adverse reaction, identified post marketing in adults.","uk":"MHRA products list Bosulif; UK Pfizer Bosulif SmPC (PLGB 00057/1551, text revised 02/2026) lists cutaneous vasculitis as an uncommon skin/subcutaneous adverse reaction, identified post marketing in adults.","us_regulator":"FDA publicly approved NDA 217729/S-002 to add cutaneous vasculitis to USPI Section 6.1 Clinical Trials Experience; no separate FAERS/AEMS potential-signal listing or Sentinel study was found in the searched FDA sources.","sources":["https://labeling.pfizer.com/ShowLabeling.aspx?id=884","https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=adc84ad5-a04d-4fee-9ba8-91f7abd928e3","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2026/217729s002lbl.pdf","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2026/217729Orig1s002ltr.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/prac-recommendation/prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-27-30-october-2025-prac-meeting_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/bosulif-epar-product-information_en.pdf","https://products.mhra.gov.uk/substance/?substance=BOSUTINIB","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/3147/smpc","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/new-safety-information-or-potential-signals-serious-risks-identified-fda-adverse-event-monitoring"]}
